authority_note: All executable Golden Classes (bridge and road) are visible in the encyclopedia. READY means published visual assets exist; PUBLISHED_LOCAL means rendered and visually reviewed assets exist in the repository but are not uploaded to a public host; CLASS_READY means an executable Class exists and visual publication is pending; PARTIAL means a declared capability is still UNRESOLVED. Vehicle Golden Classes live under the existing Wikipedia Vehicles family; Taiwan road vehicles are a regional profile.
